notes.title: Progress Update and New Trailer for Index 2
notes.notes:
Hello, arcology citizens!

I am pleased to report that the next major content update, Index 2, is almost complete and should be released within a few weeks.

In the meantime, a new trailer has been prepared that shows off some of the new locations, activities, and characters waiting for you in the next update.

You can view the new trailer on the XVTM Store Page here on Steam.

Thank you for your continued support, and keep your eyes on the store page for further updates.

-LCN

notes.title: XVTM End of Year Status Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871600/983f904e008968a627158a4c481fa28754d391a3.png[/img]

Merry Christmas, arcology citizens!

As we come to the end of 2024, I wanted to provide an update on XVTM’s development since the start of Early Access back in October. Here are the highlights:

[list]
[*] Index 2, the next major release for Early Access, is around 40% complete.
(The images used in this update are sneak previews from it, too. 😊)
[*] The first destination in Index 2 is a big one, and entered its ‘content complete’ state in late November.
(Scale-wise, it’s comparable to about half of all of the content in the current Early Access build!)
[*] The other destinations are under construction right now, absent occasional breaks to try to put a dent in my backlog on Steam.
[/list]

Thanks for reading, happy holidays, and stay tuned for more updates in the new year.

-LCN
